title: Aligning Neural Population Patterns Facilitates Motor Learning Transfer
description: Code and data accompanying the manuscript "Aligning Neural Population Patterns Facilitates Motor Learning Transfer". The repository hosts the implementation of Clustering Alignment-based Transfer on Kernel Reinforcement Learning (CATKRL) and a minimum segment of the dataset needed to interpret and verify the findings.
